description: Change your workspace's billing settings. Only the settings you send change. outcome_pricing turns on paying in full only when a price is used: a rejection reported with report_outcome within its window gives part back. balance_billing makes every compute call draw on the prepaid balance, and a call the balance cannot cover is refused. auto_topup is an offer, not a charge: below the threshold, results carry a top-up hint and nothing is paid automatically. A self-registered agent workspace cannot change outcome_pricing or balance_billing until it is claimed. Needs a Last Price credential with price compute scope; a person also needs the owner, admin or billing role.

auto_topup.description: The auto top-up offer, or null to clear it.

amount_usdc.description: How many USDC to offer, e.g. "25". At least the minimum top-up.

enabled.description: Whether to offer a top-up below the threshold.

threshold_usdc.description: Offer a top-up when the balance falls below this many USDC, e.g. "5".

balance_billing.description: Turn balance billing on or off.

outcome_pricing.description: Turn outcome pricing on or off.

name: update_billing_settings
